study_identification_part.si_4_title: Shared differential factors underlying individual spontaneous neural activity abnormalities in major depressive disorder

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Two multi-center datasets: DIDA-MDD and REST-meta-MDD consortium.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "This study included two extensive multi-center datasets comprising 2424 patients with MDD and 2183 HCs sourced from the Disease Imaging Data Archiving-Major Depressive Disorder Working Group (DIDA-MDD) and REST-meta-MDD consortium."

answer.DIDA-MDD: discovery dataset for primary analyses and normative modeling

answer.REST-meta-MDD: validation dataset for replication; used in cross-dataset evaluation

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Analyses were conducted in the discovery dataset and replicated in the validation dataset.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "All analyses were initially conducted in the discovery dataset and subsequently replicated in the validation dataset unless specified otherwise."; "The validation dataset was sourced from the REST-meta-MDD consortium"

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: HC counts reported for each dataset; no train/validation split counts reported.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "the final sample included 1148 patients with MDD ... and 1079 HCs"; "comprising 25 research sites with 1276 patients diagnosed with MDD ... and 1104 HCs"

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: HC age statistics are reported as mean ± SD (years) for each dataset; train-phase values not reported.

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Female counts computed from total HC N and reported female %; male_n = total - female_n.
